effect_description_eng: When you would play this card from your hand, if your opponent has a Digimon with ＜Security A.＞ in play, reduce its play cost by 3.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security card.).
